spec: Part VIII 8.1 — Achievements (V45–V50, appended 2026-09-04); shared/seed/achievements.json rules; V35; 5.6.1 Award.achievement(id); E8 (unlocks fold into the celebration)

vectors.title: the first workout post earns First flame and Showed up, in seed order
vectors.spec: 8.1 V45; seed first-flame (postsTotal 1) + showed-up (workoutsCompleted 1); Flow 1 step 6; Flow 2
vectors.rule: Both counters reach their thresholds on the same event; the awards come out in seed order (first-flame before showed-up) and both ids are now earned.

vectors.title: an achievement is earned once — the same or higher counters award nothing again
vectors.spec: 8.1 V46; seed rules (earned once, the first time the trigger reaches threshold); V35
vectors.rule: With first-flame and showed-up already earned, counters at or above their thresholds produce no award and leave the earned list unchanged.

vectors.title: streak achievements fire exactly at 7, 30 and 100 — and catch up in seed order
vectors.spec: 8.1 V47; seed seven-straight / thirty / century (currentStreak); Part IV streak health; Flow 7
vectors.rule: 6 earns nothing; 7 earns seven-straight; 30 with seven-straight earned earns thirty; 100 with both earns century; 100 with nothing earned yet earns all three at once, in seed order.

vectors.title: perfect weeks: 1 then 5; a streak that falls to 0 afterwards removes nothing
vectors.spec: 8.1 V48; seed perfect-week / five-perfect-weeks (perfectWeeks); V13; G6; V35 (never removed)
vectors.rule: perfectWeeks 1 earns perfect-week; 5 earns five-perfect-weeks; then every counter at 0 (a broken streak, no perfect weeks in the fold) awards nothing and the earned list is untouched.

vectors.title: crew achievements: found your crew, hype, all in, perfect crew week — and leaving removes nothing
vectors.spec: 8.1 V49; seed found-your-crew (crewJoined) / hype (reactionsGiven) / all-in (crewFullPulseDays) / perfect-crew-week (crewFullPulseWeeks); Flow 6; V37; V38
vectors.rule: All four crew counters at 1 award the four crew achievements in seed order; after leaving (crewJoined 0) with everything earned, nothing is awarded and nothing is lost.

vectors.title: new best, saved by the shield, back in it, fifty workouts — thresholds met together, seed order kept
vectors.spec: 8.1 V50; seed new-best (prCount) / saved-by-the-shield (shieldsConsumed) / back-in-it (comebacks) / fifty-workouts (workoutsCompleted 50); Flow 3; V15; V29; Flow 9
vectors.rule: With showed-up already earned, workoutsCompleted 50 + prCount 1 + shieldsConsumed 1 + comebacks 1 award exactly the four remaining solo achievements those counters reach, in seed order; 49 workouts and prCount 0 award only the shield and comeback ones.
